items.title: Charlie Love Interview, 1960-05-10
items.q: He seen Earl Offred playing trombone, you know, and Earl used to play loud trombone, you know.

ctx.x: John Casimir was scared to death of that stuff. Yeah? Oh yeah, you didn't know that? No, I didn't know that. Oh man, I saw Thomas Jefferson kid him one day at a parade. You know, make those motions like he was going to throw something on him. And Casimir was scared to death. He practically quit playing and it was his band.

We had a fella in Mississippi, we used to call him See Me Now. You know, why we give him that name? You know, comedian fellas is funny, you know. They see fellas do something funny and they make something out of it. This fella come up one day, they used to get passes, you see. Bring their sweetheart to the show or something like that. You get a pass, you could bring his gun, you see. Well, this was one of the canvas boys, you know. People was kind of scared of him too, said he was a fool. He always was fooling…
See we're talking about Simi Now, you say he played trombone with the band even though
